hostOverride: knowledge

  className: nginx
chunks.excerpt:
image:
  tag: latest
forceRestart: true
replicaCount: 1
hostOverride: knowledge
ingress:
  enabled: true
  className: nginx

chunks.text:
# namespaces/dev/configs/knowledge-api/values.yaml.gotmpl :: env, resources
env:
  qdrantUrl: "http://qdrant:6333"
  qdrantCollectionCode: "kalisio_code"
  qdrantCollectionMetadata: "knowledge_metadata"
  # must stay in step with knowledge-ingestion
  embeddingModel: "Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B"
  llmEndpoint: "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/"
  llmModel: "claude-sonnet-4-6"
  llmApiKey:
    key: knowledge-llm-api-key
  appSecret:
    key: knowledge-app-secret
  logLevel: "INFO"
resources:
  requests:
    cpu: "500m"
    memory: "2Gi"
  limits:
    memory: "4Gi"
